description: This file exports constants and a module object related to diagram rendering, including functions for managing classes, relations, styles, and event handling in a diagramming tool.

classes.name: c
classes.description: Represents a class member (method or attribute) with parsing and display logic.

methods.name: getDisplayDetails
methods.description: Returns a display string and style for the class member.

methods.name: parseMember
methods.description: Parses member string to extract visibility, id, parameters, return type, and classifier.

methods.name: parseClassifier
methods.description: Returns CSS style based on classifier symbol.
